messages:
Maya: quick heads up — the migration guide build failed linkcheck in CI after the heading rewrite. Failing fragment: #custom-output. CI run: https://ci.redwood/12345
DocsBot: build #12345 failed — linkcheck error in docs site build
DocsBot: ```text
LinkCheckError: Couldn't resolve fragment '#custom-output' in /guides/migrate/index.md referenced from /cli/export.md: line 42
``` 
Chris: which file has that heading now? is it renamed or removed?
Maya: path is `docs/guides/migrate/index.md` — we changed heading from "Custom output" to "Custom output format" in yesterday's PR and forgot to include an explicit id
Aditya: easiest fix is to add an explicit id on the heading or keep the old slug. e.g. `### Custom output format {#custom-output}`
Aditya: alternatively add `attr_list` extension and rely on auto ids but explicit is safer for cross-file fragments
Maya: here's the minimal patch I tested locally:
```diff
@@ docs/guides/migrate/index.md
-### Custom output format
+### Custom output format {#custom-output}
```
Sophia: I can open a tiny PR and get it merged today — will run `mkdocs build --strict` locally first
Sophia: also updated `docs/cli/export.md` to point to `/guides/migrate/#custom-output`
Chris: run the linkcheck locally with `mkdocs build --strict` or `mkdocs serve` + link checker plugin
Aditya: FYI we should also consider centralizing fragment names before the next migration; docsite search/redirects can mask these issues
DocsBot: PR #2048 created by Sophia: https://git.redwood/p/docs/2048 — includes heading id and updated link
Maya: thanks @Sophia — adding a quick reviewers ping @Chris @Aditya :pray:
Chris: left review, looks trivial :+1:
Aditya: merged and deployed — CI linkcheck is green now :tada:
Maya: nice, closing this thread. I'll add a short note in the migration checklist so we don't lose ids next time
